news.title: CSE announces leadership changes and 2026-27 Dean’s Fellows
news.summary_en: College of Science and Engineering (CSE) Dean Andrew Alleyne is excited to announce several leadership appointments taking place this summer, along with the appointment of the 2026-27 Dean’s Fellows.

news.title: Swannies, co founded by a CSE alumni, launches University of Minnesota licensed apparel
news.summary_en: In a true full-circle milestone, College of Science and Engineering and Carlson School of Management alumni are going back to their roots with the launch of the new University of Minnesota licensed apparel for their brand, Swannies.
